artifact: MoolSocial Buy final adversarial HTML UX audit
scope: Founder-review HTML only. Screens 01-03, native Flutter, deployment and physical-device production gates were not changed.
final_corrections: Every scrollable surface uses the same narrow, rounded mercury-manometer scrollbar with a glass-like metallic highlight.
Deliberate scrolling emits a low-volume 21 ms detent tick and a 3 ms supported-device vibration at controlled intervals; programmatic scrolling stays silent.
Scroll feedback is rate-limited, requires recent user scroll intent and is disabled when reduced motion is requested.
The complete product-detail fulfilment-partner name wraps on 320 px screens.
Long Shop and Wholesale pack descriptions remain visible at 140 percent text.
Medicine brand, title, ingredient and pack text remain visible at 140 percent text.
Medicine continuation remains three-column on wider screens and adapts to two usable columns on compact screens.
Medicine rail width adapts on 360-419 px devices so adjacent product cards remain usable.
Mixed-cart scope text and counts remain at or above the 8 px compact-review minimum.
Shop, Wholesale and Medicine now render product facts, delivery and named fulfilment before the purchase control; Add, Use Rx or the quantity stepper is the final card element.
Shop, Wholesale and Medicine share one product-tile typography scale for kicker, title, detail, pack, price, delivery and fulfilment facts.
The delivery-address control now fits its content and keeps the chevron beside the saved address instead of consuming the full header width.
The generic single-choice ecommerce filter was replaced by a branded MoolSocial decision lens with simultaneous delivery, price and fulfilment priorities.
Shop, Wholesale and Medicine own isolated filter state, labels, search scope and product matching; switching surfaces preserves each surface without leaking another catalogue's rules.
Shop supports Anytime, Fast delivery, Today, Lowest delivered price, nearby sellers and return-eligible choices.
Wholesale supports Any schedule, Fastest delivery, Within two days, Lowest wholesale price, freight included, flexible MOQ and manufacturer supply.
Medicine supports Anytime, Fast delivery, Today, Lowest delivered price, non-prescription products, nearby licensed pharmacy and manufacturer supply.
Shop, Wholesale, Medicine and Orders remain visible together in the Buy dock after every tap and throughout vertical scrolling; no paging, horizontal swipe or hidden dock state remains.
Cart uses the prior compact floating position above the Buy dock. Its 154 x 44 px resting state keeps total quantity and payable total visible without replacing any Buy subaction.
After Shop, Wholesale or Medicine Add, Cart expands to 270 x 44 px for 2.6 seconds to identify the added product, then contracts to its compact resting state without disappearing.
